descricao: The hallways of Level 74 bear visual resemblances to the main seating area, with brick walls and tiled flooring. These hallways are relatively expansive, with all of them having various popcorn machines and posters. The posters in question resembling carnival posters, with each main image being a drawing of a seemingly random Level. Notably, some of the images are of currently unrecognised Levels. The hallways themselves contain stairways, elevators, three-way and four-way intersections. These hallways all loop back around to another door of Level 74's seating area.
